title: Nice, but not worth the full price
text: I tried this for one month when there was a half off sale. I got several cool things for my furbabies. There were several toys, a crinkly mat, and some treats in it. The kitties loved most of the toys. The toy mice in it weren’t that great of quality, but the others were. The kitties were also huge fans of the treats-some weird cranberry and chicken flavored ones that I expected them to hate. I think if the price was $11 everytime, instead of just the first box, that it would be worth it, but I definitely don’t think it’s worth $19.
label: neutral
